BE IT ORDAINED BYTHE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITYOFCHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, t>e amended by changing all of the RT-4,
Residential Two-Flat, Townhpuse and Multi-Unit District symbols and Indications as
shown on Map No. 3-F in the area bound by:

      a line 165.98 feet south of and parallel to West North Avenue; North Lartabee Street;
      West Blackhawk Street if extended west where no street exists; and the vacated West
      North Frontier Street,

to those of a POS-1, Parks and Open Space District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
